meta.title: A sign, designed for you | Lit Neon
meta.description: Someone designed a neon sign for you. Open the link to watch it light up.

defaultMessage: Someone designed this sign for you.
copyFail: Copy didn't work — press and hold the address bar to copy it.

intro.h1: Send a sign that switches itself on
intro.lede: Design a sign, add a message, and send a link. When they open it, the sign lights up in a room, with your note beneath it. No prices, ever.
intro.s1: Type their name, a date or a line only the two of you get. Pick the lettering and colour.
intro.s2: Open Share, choose Gift link and add a message of up to 140 characters and your name.
intro.s3: WhatsApp, email or a QR code. They watch it light up; the link carries no prices.
intro.note: The link holds the design itself, so nothing is stored or sent until you share it.
intro.broken: That gift link looks incomplete, so we couldn't draw the sign. Ask the sender to copy it again.
intro.exampleMessage: Happy birthday. Thirty looks good on you.
